high_level_description: This image is a black-and-white cartoon illustration that humorously depicts the separation between religion and science, as envisioned by the founding fathers of the United States. The title at the top reads, "INTELLIGENT DESIGN (the one by our founding fathers)." The illustration is divided into two main sections: Church: This section is labeled with various religious symbols such as crosses, stars, and a menorah, representing different religions. It is situated on the left side of the image, separated from the state by a large high wall.
